description: Canonical adoption gates for autoresearch runner. Changes to this file MUST go through a git PR. Runner hashes this file at start and refuses to continue if the hash changes mid-campaign.
rationale: Phase 1.c/d (2026-04-20): added minSaneOosDrawdownPct=2.0 (8yr MaxDD <2% is TRAILING_LOCK fingerprint) and maxSanePerTradeEdge=0.95 (mean credit-spread edge near 1.0 is the same bug class, spotted at per-trade granularity). Both were on 'manual check' in docs/backtest-trust-gotchas.md; moved to enforced gates. Prior basis (Phase 0.a.2 2026-04-18): extracted from runner.ts inline constants.

AUTORESEARCH_MIN_OOS_TRADES.reason: Diagnostics / smoke tests with shortened selection windows need a prorated minimum
